body.html:
🔗 Explore the Project Here: https://nb41f002.github.io/bamboo-music/

"What if we could turn Classical Chinese prose into modern pop songs using SUNO? Could that spark students' interest in ancient literature?"

This spark of inspiration came from Professor Dong during a poster session at the NYCU (National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University) conference on May 25th. After returning to Tainan from Taipei, I decided to turn this idea into immediate action. Within just one month, I independently developed and launched this cross-disciplinary project: 【Bamboo Music (竹簡樂府)】.

To validate the concept, I became my own guinea pig. Right before the competitive entrance exam for teacher education programs on May 30th, I chose not to do any traditional revision for the Chinese Language Arts subject. Instead, I simply listened to the classical prose songs I had transformed with AI. Remarkably, the exam featured a question directly related to Qu Yuan's 'The Fisherman' (漁父)—and I aced it thanks to the lyrics I had been looping!

This experience solidified my belief: When text is set to melody, memory takes flight.

🛠️ My Multimodal Generative AI Workflow

To elevate this website from just "a music album" into a fully realized Educational Technology (EdTech) product, I built a pipeline integrating multiple AI tools and techniques:

  • Music & Contextual Composition (Gemini & SUNO): I leveraged Gemini to analyze the historical context of the classical texts and tailor modern Mandopop styles. The most time-consuming part was "phonetic correction." Due to SUNO's pronunciation quirks and polyphonic Chinese characters (破音字), I cross-checked every single character against traditional annotations. I also designed the Bridge for conceptual explanation and the Chorus to emphasize core themes.

  • Visual Atmosphere Generation (Gemini & Teacher Insights): Inspired by a conversation with a public vocational high school Chinese teacher at the NKNU (National Kaohsiung Normal University) conference on May 15th, I translated the poetic imagery of the lyrics into prompts. Gemini then generated gorgeous, atmospheric backgrounds that matched each song perfectly.

  • Dynamic Lyrics & Timestamp Alignment (Claude, Colab & Audio Tools): Claude generated the base SRT files. I then had Gemini write a Python script (run via Google Colab) to automate the audio-to-text alignment using raw vocals extracted from SUNO. For complex sections like Rap, I edited the vocals in Goldwave and manually fine-tuned the timestamps using Subtitle Edit.

  • 3D Front-End Web Development (Claude Design): Spent 3 days polishing a responsive web interface featuring 3D-rendered bamboo scrolls, glowing particle effects, and drifting flower petals. I successfully integrated a dynamic lyrics panel to replicate a YouTube Music-like immersive experience.

📈 The Future Roadmap

With the first 10 tracks now live, I am planning the next phases of the project:

  1. Distributing the album to Spotify and other major streaming platforms via Indiefy.
  2. Integrating the VARK learning model to produce multi-sensory animated music videos (currently optimizing the workflow to scale production).
  3. Continuously expanding the library with more classical texts.

🙏 Acknowledgments & Call to Action

A heartfelt thank you to Professor Dong from NPUST and the high school teacher from Kaohsiung for the invaluable inspiration during the conferences. I actually brought this idea to life! 😭

I have spent countless hours refining the UI/UX for both desktop and mobile layouts. I warmly invite educators, EdTech pioneers, and tech enthusiasts to check out the website and share your valuable feedback!

🔗 前往探索專案： https://nb41f002.github.io/bamboo-music/

「如果能用 SUNO 把文言文古文散文改編成現代流行音樂，會不會更能點燃學生對古典文學的熱情？」

這顆靈感的火花，源自 5 月 25 日陽明交大研討會海報展現場，屏科大董教授的一句精闢提問。從台北返回台南後，我決定將這個點子立即付諸實踐。在短短一個月內，我獨立開發並正式推出了這個跨領域教育專案：【竹簡樂府（Bamboo Music）】。

為了驗證這個學習概念，我自己當起了第一隻白老鼠。在 5 月 30 日競爭極度激烈的師資培育生甄試前夕，我選擇完全不做任何傳統的國語文死記複習。相反地，我只是一遍又一遍聆聽自己用 AI 轉化創作的文言散文歌曲。不可思議的是，考卷上竟然直接出了一道與屈原〈漁父〉高度相關的考題——多虧了耳機裡無限循環的自製歌詞，我當場秒殺得分！

這次親身經歷更加堅定了我的信念：當文字譜上了旋律，記憶便能展翅飛翔。

🛠️ 我的多模態生成式 AI 工作流

為了讓這個網站跳脫單純「音樂專輯」的框架，昇華為一套完整的教育科技（EdTech）產品，我建構了一套整合多種 AI 工具與技術的工作管線：

  • 音樂與語境譜曲（Gemini ＆ SUNO）：我運用 Gemini 考證古典文本的歷史背景與文化語境，量身打造現代華語流行音樂風格。其中最耗時的環節是「語音校正」。由於 SUNO 的咬字特性與文言文多音字（破音字）問題，我逐字對照傳統權威注釋反覆校驗。我亦精心設計了用於概念闡釋的 Bridge（橋段）與強化核心主旨的 Chorus（副歌）。

  • 視覺氛圍意象生成（Gemini ＆ 教師實踐洞察）：受到 5 月 15 日高師大研討會上一位公立技術型高中資深國文老師對話的深刻啟發，我將歌詞中的詩意意象精煉為生圖提示詞。隨後由 Gemini 生成了瑰麗而極具沉浸氛圍的古典背景，與每首歌曲的意境完美呼應。

  • 動態歌詞與時間軸校準（Claude、Colab ＆ 專業音訊工具）：Claude 負責產出基礎 SRT 字幕。隨後我請 Gemini 撰寫 Python 腳本（在 Google Colab 上執行），利用從 SUNO 分離出的人聲乾音，全自動化完成語音與文字的時間軸對齊。針對 Rap 等高難度複雜節奏片段，我使用 Goldwave 進行人聲剪接微調，並在 Subtitle Edit 中逐格手工校準時間戳記。

  • 3D 前端網頁開發（Claude Design）：花了整整 3 天打磨出極致流暢的響應式網頁介面，呈現 3D 渲染竹簡捲軸、呼吸發光粒子與悠揚飄落的花瓣特效。我成功整合了動態滾動歌詞面板，打造出媲美 YouTube Music 等級的沉浸式美學體驗。

📈 未來發展藍圖

首批 10 首曲目正式上線後，我正著手推進下一階段規劃：

  1. 透過 Indiefy 將整張專輯正式發行至 Spotify 及各大主流音樂串流平台。
  2. 結合 VARK 學習風格模型，製作多感官沉浸式動畫音樂錄影帶（目前正持續最佳化流程以實現規模化產製）。
  3. 持續拓展經典篇章庫，收錄更多古文散文大家之作。

🙏 致謝與回饋交流

由衷感謝屏科大董教授與高雄的高中老師在學術研討會期間給予我的無價啟發。我真的把這個構想親手做出來了！😭

我投入了無數心血精雕細琢桌機與行動端的 UI/UX 體驗。熱忱邀請教育夥伴、教育科技先驅與科技愛好者前往體驗網站，並不吝分享您寶貴的建議！

body.html:
“You look incredibly young. The students are going to bully you to pieces.”

That was the cautious yet well-meaning warning I received from a veteran colleague during my first week as an Information Technology teacher at a large-scale junior high school.

Even my Principal had looked at my CV with open doubt. My entire prior teaching experience consisted of less than a year at a tiny, rural elementary school. Now, I was abruptly attempting to leapfrog into a massive school to manage the brutal intensity of 18 classes simultaneously.

“Are you absolutely sure you can handle this level of intensity?” he asked bluntly.

I looked him in the eye and said: “I am willing to try. Please trust me.”

People looked at my non-traditional pedigree—a Master's in Fashion Design— and assumed a rookie with a young appearance would be swallowed alive by 500+ volatile middle school students.

They didn't realize that to a designer, a chaotic environment isn't a crisis. It's simply a system waiting to be reverse-engineered. Here is the behavioral design framework I deployed to achieve a 100% project delivery rate on complex Generative AI assignments:

1. Strategic Camouflage & The Age-Hacking Bluff

Middle school students have a built-in defense mechanism against rookie teachers. To survive, I ran a dual-layer information firewall regarding my identity.

In the faculty room, the atmosphere was wonderfully supportive. Because of my appearance, my colleagues naturally assumed I was a fresh graduate. Out of pure kindness, they showered me with protective guidance so I wouldn't get scared off by the kids. I gratefully accepted their warmth and let this "rookie camouflage" run in the background to avoid unnecessary institutional friction.

But on the classroom stage, I pulled off a tactical masterstroke on Day 1: I calmly told the students I was 40 years old, born in 1985, unmarried, and without kids, attributing my appearance solely to rigorous skincare. When they demanded to see my ID, I replied with a clear boundary: “That is a legal authority reserved strictly for law enforcement.” This unresolvable enigma kept them hyper-focused for two semesters, successfully establishing immediate positional authority.

(Plot twist: The male IT teacher sitting directly across from me in the faculty office was actually born in 1985. He knew the entire time that I was bluffing to the kids. Every time he heard the students debating my "age-defying secret," he just stared at me in pure, hilarious frustration. Thank you for not blowing my cover, colleague. 🤫)

2. Tailored Visual Authority & Cognitive Dissonance

Traditional IT teachers often rely on rigid, predictable stereotypes. Leveraging my fashion design background, I curated a personal style that was mature yet contemporary—never old-fashioned, but perfectly structured for my frame. Knowing exactly how to project visual authority allowed me to create immediate cognitive dissonance, bypassing the students' defiance.

Of course, this led to hilarious misunderstandings. During the school anniversary sports festival, I shifted away from my usual mature attire and wore a casual hoodie. A newly recruited, younger Discipline Section Chief marched over, completely mistook me for a student, and scolded me sharply: “Cell phones are meant for taking photos during the sports festival, not for playing games!” The moment I looked up, his face flushed with absolute horror, and he apologized profusely while my students snickered right beside me.

3. Unlocking the Feedback Loop: Typing Speed as a Gatekeeper

AI generation thrives on a fast-paced instant feedback loop. If a student's typing throughput lags, the cognitive stimulation cools down, leading to behavioral disengagement. To solve this, I structurally mandated Chinese touch-typing from Day 1.

Initially, many students operated at a rough baseline of around 10 to 20 words per minute (WPM). To track progress scientifically, I ran a strict matched-pair analysis (N = 481 students), controlling for textual difficulty across identical milestones.

Even when facing a more complex post-test text ("The Bond of Pets," which introduced advanced punctuation and the character "牠"), the empirical data revealed a definitive system upgrade: the average typing speed rose from 23.9 WPM to 26.75 WPM—a 12.0% net increase in human bandwidth.

35% of the entire cohort showed dramatic acceleration, outnumbering those who regressed by nearly a 3-to-1 ratio. By expanding their hardware throughput, their input speed could finally sustain the high-velocity prompts required for GenAI synthesis.

Before unlocking GenAI tools, I ran a competitive "AI Ethics & Discernment" group tournament involving synthetic images, audio, and fake news. This gamified firewall forced intense collective focus before they were given the power to generate.

4. The Real-Time Dashboard Economy

I deployed ClassDojo as a live token economy. Instead of using a projector, I utilized a master system broadcast from my tablet to display the dashboard directly onto the students' individual computer screens.

Cumulative class points unlocked specific gamified, educational sandboxes at the end of the term (e.g., Hero Rise, ClassDojo Island). Conversely, non-compliance triggered unpredictable, slot-machine-style point deductions in real-time. It kept them on the edge of their seats.

5. Systemic Rules Over Emotional Drama

I eradicated emotional friction by implementing strict, school-regulation demerit SOPs:

  • Grade 7: Disruptions triggered a demerit slip system. The student assistant delivered the slip to the homeroom teacher to be pasted onto the communication book, alerting parents to monitor their child's behavior. Three slips resulted in an official warning (demerit) under school regulations.
  • Grade 8: Direct official warning (demerit) under school regulations, coupled with mandatory lunch-break behavioral self-reflections in my office to logically decode why the boundary was crossed.

No yelling. No emotional drama. Just predictable consequences.

6. The Counter-Balanced Intelligence Network

Managing 500 students means preventing them from forming a united front. I structurally engineered my student assistant system by appointing two drastically different leaders per class: Agent A (the core instigator, often neurodivergent, whose institutional responsibility acted as a psychological anchor) and Agent B (the anchor of compliance).

For the notoriously difficult "demon classes," I quietly recruited the most influential outliers as covert eyes and ears, incentivizing them with tactical rewards like snacks and biscuits. Small resource allocation for absolute systemic peace.

📉 The Ultimate Stress Test

The true validity of a system isn't measured when the architect is present, but when the architect is temporarily gone.

Mid-semester, a severe bout of Norovirus forced me to take a sudden three-day medical leave. The Dean of Student Affairs and the IT Section Chief—seasoned administrative leaders—stepped in to substitute for my classes.

Upon my return, the IT Section Chief confessed to me: “We were under immense pressure while covering your classes. We were honestly terrified we might disrupt the perfect behavioral ecosystem you engineered here.”

I smiled: “Don't worry. Now that I'm back, the system resets.” The moment I stepped back onto the platform, the behavioral conditioning re-activated seamlessly.

🏁 Market Validation

You don't need a conventional pedigree to earn respect; you need a working methodology.

While my protocols were iron-clad, the human element was deeply calibrated. During breaks or after class, instead of rushing back, students would linger in the computer classroom just to crowd around me and chat. To respect my colleagues and maintain a quiet environment, I deliberately kept these interactions out of the faculty office. These teenagers would eagerly share "inside scoops" and school gossip that even their own homeroom teachers hadn't heard yet.

A year after I stepped away from the field to focus on my education academic research, the school administration reached out this week, cordially inviting me to return and retake the helm.

In the era of Generative AI, the role of an educator has permanently shifted from a passive transmitter of data to an Architect of Human Behavior. When you design a system with absolute structural integrity, even the wildest spirits will willingly align with your vision.

「你看起來太年輕了，學生一定會把你欺負得體無完膚。」

這是我在一所大型國中擔任資訊科技專任代理教師的第一週，一位資深前輩語重心長、出於善意的謹慎警告。

就連校長在面試時，看著我的履歷也寫滿了毫不掩飾的疑慮。我過去全部的教學經驗，僅有一年在極度迷你、偏遠的鄉村小學。現在，我卻驟然越級挑戰一所龐大的巨型學校，要同時迎戰整整 18 個班級、每週排山倒海而來的教學高壓。

「你真的百分之百確定自己能承受得住這種強度的挑戰嗎？」他直截了當地問。

我直視他的眼睛，平靜回答：「我願意全力以赴。請相信我。」

大家看著我非典型的出身背景——服裝設計碩士——理所當然地認定一個外表看似稚嫩的新手，一定會被 500 多名情緒躁動、正值青春期的國中生生吞活剝。

他們不知道的是，對一位設計師而言，混亂的環境從來不是危機。它純粹是一個等待著被「逆向工程」拆解重構的系統。以下是我所部署的行為設計架構，它讓全體學生在複雜的生成式 AI 實作任務中，達成了 100% 的專案交付率：

1. 策略性偽裝與「年齡迷航 Bluff」

國中生對菜鳥老師天生具備敏銳的防衛偵測機制。為了順利生存，我針對自己的身分背景啟動了雙層資訊防火牆。

在教職員辦公室裡，氣氛溫馨而充滿支持。因為外表的緣故，同事們很自然地把我當成剛踏出校門的應屆畢業生。出於純粹的善意，大家主動給予我諸多保護性的指引與提點，深怕我被頑皮的孩子嚇退。我心懷感激地接納這份溫暖，並讓這層「菜鳥偽裝」在背景默默運作，省去了不必要的體制內摩擦。

但在走進教室站上講台的第一天，我使出了一記精準的戰術殺著：我神態自若地告訴學生我已經 40 歲了，1985 年生，未婚無子，外貌全靠嚴格極致的抗老保養。當他們不信邪地起鬨要求查看我的身分證時，我劃下了清晰冷靜的法律邊界：「查看國民身分證是司法警察才享有的法定職權。」這個永遠無解的神秘謎團讓全體學生在接下來的整整兩學期中保持著極度的好奇與敬畏，成功在開局第一天就瞬間樹立了無可動搖的位階權威。

（戲劇性插曲：坐在我辦公桌正對面的男資訊老師，恰恰好就是 1985 年出生的同齡人。他從頭到尾都清楚知道我在唬爛這群屁孩。每次他在走廊聽見學生熱烈討論我的「逆齡凍齡秘訣」時，都會用極度無奈又憋笑的眼神狠狠瞪著我。謝謝你從頭到尾沒戳破我的掩護，好同事。🤫）

2. 專屬視覺權威與認知失調

傳統科技領域教師往往給人刻板、千篇一律的形象印象。善用我的服裝設計專業背景，我為自己量身打理了成熟幹練卻極具現代感的個人穿搭風格——絕不老氣，但剪裁比例完全契合我的身型架構。精準掌握如何透過視覺投射專業權威，讓我成功在學生心中製造出強烈的認知失調，直接繞過了青少年本能的叛逆抗拒心理。

當然，這也引發了令人捧腹的誤會。校慶運動會當天，我褪去了平時俐落成熟的裝扮，換上一身休閒連帽 T 恤。一位剛調來、年輕氣盛的生教組長大步走過來，完全把我當成了違規學生，厲聲喝斥：「校慶運動會帶手機是用來拍照記錄的，不是讓你躲在旁邊打電動的！」當我一抬頭與他四目相接，他的臉色瞬間刷地一聲漲得通紅，尷尬到極點不停鞠躬道歉，而我的學生們在一旁憋笑到快要內傷。

3. 解鎖反饋迴圈：打字速度作為吞吐量門檻

生成式 AI 創作極度仰賴快節奏的即時反饋迴圈。如果學生的打字輸入頻寬落後，思維的刺激就會迅速冷卻，進而導致注意力渙散與行為脫序。為了解決這個瓶頸，我從開學第一天起就強制推動中文盲打訓練。

起初，許多學生的打字速度僅能徘徊在每分鐘 10 到 20 個字（WPM）的粗糙基準線上。為了以科學方法追蹤成效，我實施了嚴謹的配對樣本分析（樣本數 N = 481 名學生），在相同的評量節點上嚴格控制文本難度。

即使在面對難度大幅提升的後測文本（〈寵物的羈絆〉，該篇引入了高階標點符號與生僻代名詞「牠」），實證數據依然展現了明確的系統躍升：全體平均打字速度從 23.9 WPM 攀升至 26.75 WPM——人類輸入頻寬實現了 12.0% 的淨成長。

高達 35% 的學生展現了極其顯著的速度爆發，打字進步人數與退步人數的比例逼近 3 比 1。透過拓寬硬體輸入的吞吐頻寬，孩子們的手速終於能支撐起生成式 AI 所需的高頻提示詞產出節奏。

在正式解鎖生成式 AI 工具之前，我先設計了一場分組對抗的「AI 倫理與辨識」錦標賽，涵蓋合成圖像、擬真音訊與假新聞辨別。這道遊戲化的防火牆，在賦予他們強大生成力量之前，先鍛鍊出了極度深刻的集體思辨與專注力。

4. 即時儀表板代幣經濟

我部署 ClassDojo 作為即時代幣經濟系統。不同於單純投影在大螢幕上，我透過平板電腦主控系統，將計分儀表板直接全螢幕廣播推播至每位學生的個人電腦螢幕前。

全班累積的團隊點數能在學期末解鎖專屬的遊戲化教育沙盒（例如 Hero Rise、ClassDojo 島嶼）。反之，脫序違規行為則會觸發即時扣分，宛如吃角子老虎機般的隨機扣點機制，讓全班每個人隨時保持在專注警覺的高峰。

5. 體制規則高於情緒內耗

我透過徹底落實合乎校規的違規單 SOP，根除了師生間的情緒內耗與拉扯：

  • 七年級：課堂脫序行為觸發違規登記單制度。由小老師送交導師貼在聯絡簿上，提醒家長共同督導。累積三張登記單則依校規正式開立警告處分。
  • 八年級：直接依校規開立正式警告處分，並強制利用午休時間前往科任辦公室進行行為自我反思，從邏輯層面深刻剖析為什麼跨越了行為紅線。

沒有歇斯底里的怒吼，沒有情緒化的戲劇場面。只有可預期、精準執行的制度後果。

6. 制衡情報網絡與雙股長制

同時管理 500 名學生，意味著必須防止他們形成集體對抗的鐵板一塊。我在體制上重新設計了資訊小老師架構，每班任命兩位特質截然相反的領導者：Agent A（核心帶頭者，通常是精力旺盛或特教邊緣的孩子，賦予體制職責能轉化為強大的心理錨定）與 Agent B（服從與秩序的定海神針）。

對於幾間全校聞名的棘手「魔王班」，我私下悄悄招募了最具號召力的靈魂人物作為耳目眼線，並以點心、餅乾等戰術資源作為獎勵。極小的資源配置，換來的是絕對的體制秩序與和諧。

📉 極限壓力測試

一套系統真正的強韌度，不是看架構師在場時有多穩定，而是看架構師暫時缺席時能否如常運轉。

學期中途，一場猛烈的諾羅病毒迫使我緊急請了整整三天病假。學務主任與資訊組長——兩位經驗極其豐富的資深行政主管——親自前來為我的班級代課。

當我銷假返校時，資訊組長由衷向我坦白：「幫妳代課那幾天我們壓力超級大。我們真的打從心底害怕自己會一不小心弄壞妳在這裡一手打造的完美行為生態系。」

我微笑了笑： 「別'擔心。既然我'回來了，系統自動重置。」 當我重新踏上講台的那一瞬間，行為制約機制無縫重新啟動。

🏁 市場驗證

你不需要傳統科班的光環來贏得尊重；你需要的是一套真正奏效的方法論。

雖然我的常規規範堅如磐石，但人性的溫度始終經過細膩校準。下課鐘響或放學後，學生們不會急著跑回教室，反而總愛擠在電腦教室團團圍著我天南地北地聊天。為了尊重辦公室同仁並維持安靜，我刻意把這些互動留在電腦教室。這些青春期的孩子們會興高采烈地向我分享各種第一手八卦與校園秘密，很多甚至連他們的班導師都還未曾耳聞。

當我離開教職一年、全心投入教育學術研究之後，學校行政團隊在這週主動聯繫了我，誠摯熱情地力邀我重返學校掌舵執教。

在生成式 AI 席捲而來的時代，教育工作者的角色已經徹底從被動的數據傳遞者，蛻變為「人類行為的架構師」。當你設計的系統具備絕對嚴密的結構完整性時，哪怕是最狂放不羈的靈魂，也會心悅誠服地與你的願景同頻共振。

cover.alt: The Architecture of Survival: How a 10-Year Battle with a Rare Disease Redesigned My Career Gaps and My Soul.

body.html:
Many looking at my resume are perplexed:

"Why transition from a master's degree in fashion design to educational management and AI?"

"Why did it take four long years to complete your first master's degree?"

"Why does your professional timeline contain career gaps that seem entirely illogical and fragmented?"

Faced with these constant queries, I used to nonchalantly brush them off with a gentle, polite smile: "My health isn't great, and teaching is what best suits my physical condition."

That was the most elegant lie I told the world—a quiet cover for a decade of breathtaking, terrifying turbulence.

What the world did not see was that those seemingly "glitched" gaps on my resume were the heavy price of survival. In a dark era before the existence of modern Generative AI, my physical body was dealt a 3.5-in-a-million hand: a rare, ruthless autoimmune disease known as Relapsing Polychondritis combined with Ankylosing Spondylitis. During those years, I lay alone in the deepest abyss, fighting a split-second race against death just to keep my vital signs stable.

The brutality of chronic autoimmune diseases is no less than that of advanced cancer. It is a lifelong, incurable sentence—often described by patients as a cancer that won't let you die. In standard medical literature, my specific overlap syndrome even carried a staggering 70% mortality rate during acute flare-ups.

At the age of 23, the world as I knew it began to spin uncontrollably. During the darkest hours when the elite medical establishment failed to find a diagnosis—and even subtly implied that my symptoms were psychosomatic, suggesting I visit a psychiatric clinic—I refused to accept that, and my stubborn need for logical answers kicked in.

I was determined not to break. Battling severe vertigo and constant nausea, I channeled the relentless, die-hard spirit of academic research. I parsed complex international medical literature word by word. Ultimately, leveraging my own precise clinical symptoms, I cross-referenced and synthesized five comprehensive medical papers, highlighting the critical logic strings with a neon green marker. Dragging a body on the absolute verge of collapse, I marched back into the clinic alone to present a rigorous, data-backed counter-argument to the elite specialists.

In the end, I won. I compelled the haughty, self-righteous physicians to admit their diagnostic oversight. More importantly, I found dedicated, open-minded doctors willing to break rigid clinical convention and embark on a tailored cocktail therapy with me.

I distinctly remember telling myself at that moment:

"My physical body may be temporarily glitched, but my mind has never lost its sovereign capacity to decode and redesign the world."

What followed, however, was a grueling game of pharmaceutical roulette. The words of the head specialist at the time were sharp and piercing: "Even spending a million New Taiwan dollars out-of-pocket wouldn't guarantee the right cure for an overlap syndrome like yours." This harsh reality illuminated the exact bottleneck and agonizing pain points of current biological agents.

After watching the standard-protocol biologic MabThera completely fail while leaving me with severe side effects like hair loss and melasma, we made a bold clinical gamble. Drawing insight from a non-typical overseas case study of a 16-year-old boy, we switched to Actemra. My immune source code was finally successfully optimized, maintaining stable control to this day.

This incredibly rare clinical data ultimately helped the two brave physicians who adventured with me publish my case report in a prominent international medical journal. Today, they have become leading authorities in the field. And I am profoundly grateful that this battle-scarred body of mine could serve as a living database, a beacon of hope guiding other rare disease patients toward their own survival.

This illness forced me to walk away from my original trajectory of pursuing a Ph.D. in fashion design. Yet, the creative fire within my soul never extinguished.

I chose to translate that foundational eye for aesthetics and that die-hard research grit entirely into the realms of Educational Management and Generative AI. To me, this transition is fundamentally a grander, more impactful form of "Life System Innovation Design."

I choose to unveil my scars today not to auction off suffering, but to send a powerful message to fellow professional travelers navigating their own winters: The hardships of life are not designed to permanently break your system; they are meant to strip away the superficial noise so you can rise again to drive deeper, structural change.

As an educator, my absolute insistence on exploring advanced AI alongside my students stems from a simple resolve: Within my limited timeline, I want to ensure the next generation is equipped with an unconstrained, pioneering mindset, completely free from traditional educational boundaries.

It is also my ultimate, long-term aspiration that one day, my students—or the brilliant scientists currently working on the frontlines—will utilize big data to optimize complex biologic structures and develop long-acting formulations. By doing so, we can radically eliminate the economic burdens and intense physical pain points endured by rare disease patients during monthly intravenous infusions.

My name is Zoe Yeh. My life took a major turn, and though my body suffered a catastrophic failure, I was never defeated. Through AI and education, I am ready to reshape a future of limitless possibilities.

#RareDiseaseSurvival #GenerativeAI #BioTechData

許多看過我履歷的人都感到困惑：

「為什麼會從服裝設計碩士，跨界轉向教育管理與生成式 AI？」

「為什麼妳的第一個碩士學位花了漫長的整整四年才完成？」

「為什麼妳的職涯時間軸上，會出現幾段看似完全不合常理、支離破碎的經歷空白？」

面對這些接踵而來的疑問，過去的我總是帶著溫柔而禮貌的微笑輕輕帶過：「我身體不太好，教書這份工作比較能配合我的體能狀況。」

那是這輩子我向世界說過最優雅的謊言——用來輕描淡寫地掩蓋那段長達十年、驚濤駭浪且令人窒息的生死風暴。

世人所沒有看見的是，履歷上那些看似「故障當機」的年資空白，是我為了活下去所付出的慘烈代價。在現代生成式 AI 尚未問世的黑暗年代，我的肉身拿到了每百萬人中僅約 3.5 人的罕見手牌：一種極其罕見且殘酷的自體免疫疾病——復發性多軟骨炎（Relapsing Polychondritis, RP）合併僵直性脊椎炎（Ankylosing Spondylitis, AS）。在那段歲月裡，我孤身一人深陷在最黑暗的深淵中，為了維持最基本的生命跡象，分分秒秒都在與死神進行極限拔河。

慢性自體免疫疾病的殘酷程度，絲毫不亞於癌症末期。它是一場終身無法治癒的無期徒刑——常被病友痛楚地形容為「死不了的癌症」。在正規的醫學文獻中，我所罹患的這種特殊重疊綜合症，在急性發作期甚至曾記載有高達 70% 的致死率。

23 歲那年，我所認識的整個世界開始天旋地轉、分崩離析。在最絕望的至暗時刻，頂尖醫療機構的權威醫師始終找不出病因——甚至隱晦暗示我的症狀純屬心理身心症，建議我去掛精神科門診。我斷然拒絕接受這種敷衍，骨子裡那股對邏輯真相近乎偏執的渴求被徹底點燃。

我下定決心絕不向命運屈服。強忍著天旋地轉的劇烈暈眩與無休止的噁心嘔吐，我拿出了學術研究者死磕到底的硬核精神。我逐字逐句啃讀國際權威醫學文獻。最終，結合自己精確的臨床病徵，我交叉比對並歸納了五篇大型醫學論文，用螢光綠色筆逐一標註出關鍵的病理邏輯鏈。拖著那具瀕臨崩潰瓦解的身軀，我獨自一人重返診間，拿著扎實的文獻數據，向那些權威專家提出了無懈可擊的反駁與質疑。

最終，我贏了。我迫使那些高高在上、自以為是的權威醫師坦承診斷上的疏漏。更重要的是，我找到了真正具備醫德與開闊胸襟的良醫，願意打破僵化的傳統臨床常規，與我一同冒險展開量身訂做的量身打造的雞尾酒療法。

我依然清晰記得，在那個關鍵時刻我告訴自己的一句話：

「我的肉體或許遭遇了暫時性的系統故障，但我的大腦，從未失去解碼並重新設計這個世界的主權。」

然而，隨之而來的，是一場殘酷痛苦的藥物俄羅斯輪盤。當時的主治權威主任說得字字誅心：「像妳這樣罕見的重疊綜合症，就算自費花上一百萬台幣，也不保證能找到合適的治療方法。」這番血淋淋的現實，道盡了當前生物製劑的研發瓶頸與患者痛徹心扉的煎熬。

在親眼目睹標準療程的第一線生物製劑 MabThera徹底宣告無效，並留給我嚴重脫髮與肝斑等猛烈副作用後，我們做出了一次大膽的臨床豪賭。借鏡海外一篇 16 歲少年的非典型病例研究，我們毅然換用 Actemra。我的免疫原始碼終於被成功最佳化，病情穩定控制並維持至今。

這份極其珍貴的罕見臨床數據，最終協助與我一同並肩冒險的兩位勇敢醫師，將我的病例報告成功發表在知名國際醫學期刊上。如今，他們已成為該領域該領域的權威專家。而我由衷感恩，這具歷經戰火摧殘的軀體，能成為一座活生生的數據庫，化為一座希望的燈塔，指引其他罕病患者尋得一線生機。

這場大病迫使我痛別原本出國攻讀服裝設計博士的人生軌道。然而，深植在我靈魂深處的創作烈火，從未有一刻真正熄滅過。

我選擇將那份對美學架構的敏銳底蘊，與死磕到底的研究硬骨氣，全數轉化傾注進「教育管理」與「生成式 AI」的嶄新領域。對我而言，這場跨界轉型，本質上正是格局更為宏大、影響更為深遠的「生命系統創新設計」。

今天我選擇主動揭開身上的傷疤，絕非為了拍賣苦難、博取同情，而是想向每一位正在漫長寒冬中踽踽獨行的同行者傳遞一份堅定的力量：生命中的嚴峻苦難，從來不是為了徹底摧毀你的系統；它的存在，是為了洗淨所有浮泛的噪音，讓你能浴火重生，去推動更深層、更具結構性的變革。

作為一名教育者，我之所以無比固執地堅持帶著學生探索尖端 AI，純粹源於一份純粹的初衷：在有限的人生維度裡，我渴望確保下一代能擁有不受拘束、敢於拓荒的開創思維，徹底擺脫傳統教育的僵化邊界。

這亦是我終生不變的長遠宏願：期盼未來的某一天，我的學生們——或是目前堅守在前線的頂尖科學家們——能善用大數據最佳化複雜的生物製劑分子結構，研發出超長效型劑型。唯有如此，才能從根本上徹底終結罕病患者每個月在靜脈點滴注射中所承受的沉重經濟重擔與肉體劇痛。

我的名字是 Zoe Yeh。我的人生曾經歷過驚濤駭浪的轉折，我的肉身曾遭遇災難性的嚴重故障，但我從未被擊敗。透過 AI 與教育，我已全副武裝，準備好重塑充滿無限可能的嶄新未來。

#RareDiseaseSurvival #GenerativeAI #BioTechData
